narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives ran exactly alike. In month {fork_month}, you chose {real_choice} and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. From then on the ghost's money sat above yours for {ghost_ahead_months} months. In month {layoff_month}, with both of you out of work, the ghost was {layoff_net_worth_gap}. At month {end_month}, the ghost finished {net_worth_gap}. How long each of you could last on no salary came out {safety_gap}.
